name: Gopal On Ceiling Fan
visual_description: Ajay Devgn as Gopal from Golmaal perched on a ceiling fan, smirking mischievously downwards.
usage_context: Used to express smugness, eavesdropping, or silently catching someone off guard from an unexpected vantage point.
